question: Evidence gathered for the from-zero stage on the reused prior pool, reference region F_b011_s030__reference. Measured: parent S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY has 40 active/nonzero coordinate updates, mean injected RMS ~0.0301 A, mean point RMS ~0.169 A, zero atom and cumulative clipping, assignment-switch fraction mean ~0.0020; terminal outcome U_tau=0.01246, best_qualified_pic50=8.434, hit_fraction=0.042, mean_all_pic50=7.827, 0 above target. Measured: conditional_layout reports 10 fixed-geometry legal layouts, native_score 8.704859, native_minus_alternate_mean 0.0763, n_identifiable_interactions=0, native N site 22; single N->N exchanges span delta_score -0.441 to +0.207, so no single N relocation is uniformly favorable. Measured: regional_context shows same_graph controls n=0 and same_root controls n=40 (dependent), with pocket-field distances for O_acceptor and N_acceptor roles; these are field associations, not proven contacts or energies. Measured: regional_trajectories are historical_steer_not_current_guidance, domain [0,0.5], with descriptive ancestor vs contrast fits (e.g. signed_dx ancestor net_rate -0.340 vs contrast +0.061; signed_dz ancestor +0.172 vs contrast -0.105); no p-values, no time-bin tests, no spatial-gradient interpretation. Inferred: the reference region's native N/O roles are retained at terminal states only as source terminal chemistry, not as a measured retention of generated identities; formation, retention, and terminal-affinity value remain separate and the retention link is unmeasured. Proposed: the actionable observable for this region is a local displacement/role-conditioned site field over the supplied local support (atom_slots, units A, Hungarian matching to teacher ligand points, target direction/band from base_band_A=0.3491 and band_multiplier=1.0), with the pocket_distance variant comparing every matched local ligand point to every supplied pocket site. Counterevidence: every tested operator (local_moments, pocket_distance, point_band, pointwise) and every tested region produced lower tail utility than the reference, and all rollbacks (R04, R08_v2, R10_v2, R12_v2, R14_v2) were geometry-attainment failures rather than affinity gains; the source report also finds no significant carboxyl O-only intervention and no universal Top10 motif. Capability gaps: no binding-energy or interaction-energy calculator is registered, so no energy claim is made; no tool measures generated-atom N/O identity retention at terminal states, so that link stays unmeasured. No further tool round is needed to select one principal intervention; the next step is a bounded from-zero experiment changing one legal factor on this region, with a falsifier that the retained local change does not improve terminal affinity.
